description.narrative:
This consultancy aims to provide capacity building, monitoring and reporting support to our CPT livelihoods partner in Pará, four indigenous partners in the Amazon, and two children’s right urban partners in Recife.
The consultant will provide monitoring and technical capacity support to CPT/MA-XI-TU in the finalisation of the EC Year 2 report which is due beginning of November, analysing all relevant partner documentation, annexes and draft reports, and providing feedback and reporting support to ensure all documentation is produced meeting EC guidelines.
The consultant will also review and analyse key partner documentation and reports and prepare programmatic and financial monitoring and reporting feedback for six other indigenous and child rights partners, capturing and highlighting main changes, adaptations and areas for partner monitoring and CAFOD PCM in the next year, which will inform CAFOD’s grant approval process.
Due to an overload of work and illness of a member of the team (Programme Support Officer’s recent health problems) and end of the year monitoring and evaluation trip, and CR support to Andes team (security management and approvals sign off), the support is required to ensure continued monitoring and PCM support to partners and clear a backlog of tasks that have built up as a result of all the above unforeseen situations. This support is important in order to avoid further delays which will consequently have an impact on partners work and our relationship with the EU delegation in Brazil. This support is also essential to allow time for PSO full recovery and a stress free return and for the whole team wellbeing.
Support will be provided by Lorna Muscat, previous CAFOD Programme Officer – Brazil and Paraguay, utilising her experience from supporting the implementation of a previous EC contract for the Brazil Urban Livelihoods programme between 2008-11 and her knowledge of the Brazil programmes, projects, partners and CAFOD's requirements.
